about: Local corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build_resort.py for Chamrousse. Rule (as for Saint-Lary): where OSM and the official resort data disagree, the official data wins; names follow the official piste map. Evidence and open questions: docs/official-comparison.md (Chamrousse section).
officialSources: https://www.chamrousse.com/medias/images/info_pages/plan-alpin-2627-web-3644.pdf (official 'Alpine Park' piste map 2026/27, linked from chamrousse.com/plan-pistes-alpin.html; pistes are coloured vector lines with coloured labels, read by eye on a 300 dpi render, 2026-10-29)
https://tiles.openskimap.org/geojson/runs.geojson + lifts.geojson (OpenSkiMap export of 2026-10-28; extract kept in data/chamrousse/raw/openskimap-*.geojson)

dropLifts.1256730818: Wakeboard cable tow (summer water-ski lift on the lake), not a ski lift.
dropLifts.104004202: Unnamed 20 m drag lift; not on the official map.

acceptNearGaps.why: Same rule as Saint-Lary: piste ends that miss the next piste by at most 30 m are treated as connected.
